disagreements.required_change: Require None or literal canonical transfer-id string; malformed values fail closed and remain affectively neutral; exact format policy TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: consumed_transfer_ids is trusted by MutableSet interface without an authoritative atomic/durable exactly-once store contract.
disagreements.required_change: Require deterministic membership plus atomic durable consume/read-after-write or equivalent primitive; exact store policy TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: overlap_shift does not bind compact_state and transfer_identity to one immutable authoritative snapshot. It computes compact_torque_state(active_state), then transfer_identity recomputes compact_torque_state(active_state) and separately rereads mission_id/step_id. A mutable, concurrent, or adversarial Mapping can therefore yield a returned compact fingerprint from snapshot A while transfer_id is derived from snapshot B/C.
disagreements.required_change: Capture one immutable validated authority snapshot once per shift attempt and derive compact_state, state_fingerprint, mission_id, step_id and transfer_id exclusively from that snapshot. Reject mutation/version drift before ACK-capable completion. Snapshot mismatch/retry telemetry must remain affectively neutral. Snapshot/version contract and concurrency policy TEST_REQUIRED.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
RECEIVER_IDENTITY_STRICT_TYPES: custom equality/non-string fingerprint or transfer-id values never satisfy ACK or execution_authorized.
IDEMPOTENCY_STORE_CONTRACT: non-durable/custom store and concurrent consume attempts authorize at most one completion; exact atomicity model TEST_REQUIRED.

SINGLE_SNAPSHOT_TRANSFER_BINDING: adversarial Mapping returns different values on repeated get(); compact_state fingerprint, mission_id, step_id and transfer_id must all derive from one captured snapshot or fail closed.

AUTHORITY_MUTATION_DURING_SHIFT: mutate mission/step/RPM fields between snapshot capture and ACK; execution_authorized must remain false unless receiver ACK binds the exact immutable snapshot/version.

SNAPSHOT_DRIFT_REPLAY_STORM: 10000 snapshot-version mismatches/retries versus zero with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => Experience/recurrence/threat/competence/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state byte-identical.
SNAPSHOT_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: snapshot mismatch/version/retry telemetry has no direct path to Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
